From Fender: Fuzz is essential to the sound of modern music. Ranging from smooth and polite to sputtering and broken-sounding, this effect is the heart of rock and roll. The Trapper® combines two discrete fuzz voices into one chassis with global Tone and Contour controls to shape your sound to taste. The softer-sounding first voice includes a switchable high octave - perfect for generating synth-like tones - while the grittier second voice includes a highly interactive noise gate. Designed by our in-house team of experts, the Trapper® Dual Fuzz is an all-original Fender circuit. The chassis is crafted from lightweight, durable anodized aluminum, and the Amp Jewel LED gives your pedalboard the classic Fender look. The switchable LED-backlit knobs show your control settings on a dark stage at a glance. sources.excerpt: Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz User Manual PDF | Manualsnet --> Fender Effects Pedal The Trapper Dual Fuzz Manuals Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Manual Pages 8 Year 2019 Language(s) en Share PDF Preview Previous of 8 GO Next Previous of 8 GO Next Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal Specification The Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal presents a versatile solution for musicians seeking a dynamic range of fuzz tones. This pedal features a dual-circuit design, offering two distinct fuzz voices that can be engaged independently or combined for a rich, layered sound. The first fuzz circuit delivers a classic, warm fuzz tone with a smooth sustain, ideal for vintage-inspired riffs. The second circuit introduces a modern, aggressive fuzz with a gated effect, adding a unique texture to your sound palette. Each circuit is equipped with its own set of controls, including gain, tone, and volume, allowing precise tonal shaping. The pedal is constructed with a rugged anodized aluminum chassis, ensuring durability for stage performances and studio sessions. Its true bypass switching maintains signal integrity, preventing any loss of tone when the pedal is not engaged. The Trapper Dual Fuzz also includes an octave-up feature, accessible via a dedicated footswitch, adding harmonic richness and enhancing the overall sonic experience. Power is supplied through a standard 9V DC power adapter, providing convenience for integration into existing pedalboards. Designed with both novice and professional guitarists in mind, the pedal's intuitive layout facilitates easy operation while offering extensive tonal flexibility. Its compact size ensures it fits comfortably within any pedal setup, making it a versatile addition to your effects collection. The Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal embodies a blend of classic and contemporary fuzz tones, making it a valuable tool for exploring new sonic territories. Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal F.A.Q. How do I power the Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal? The Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal requires a 9V DC power supply with a negative center pin. Ensure that the power supply delivers at least 100mA for optimal performance. What should I do if the pedal is not producing any sound? Check the power supply connection, ensure your cables are securely connected, and verify that the pedal is not bypassed. Also, check your amplifier and guitar connections. Can I use a battery to power the pedal? No, the Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal does not support battery power. It requires a 9V DC power supply. How can I achieve a more aggressive fuzz tone with the pedal? To achieve a more aggressive fuzz tone, increase the Fuzz and Tone controls on the pedal. Experiment with the Octave switch for added harmonic content. What is the function of the Octave switch on the pedal? The Octave switch adds an octave-up effect to your fuzz tone, providing a more complex and harmonically rich sound. How do I maintain the pedal for long-term use? Keep the pedal clean and dry. Regularly check and tighten input/output jacks, and store the pedal in a protective case when not in use. Avoid exposing it to extreme temperatures. What should I do if the footswitch is not engaging properly? Ensure that there is no debris obstructing the footswitch. If problems persist, consider contacting Fender customer support for servicing options. Can I use the pedal with a bass guitar? Yes, the pedal can be used with a bass guitar, though the tonal characteristics may differ. Adjust the Tone and Fuzz controls to better suit bass frequencies. What are the dimensions of the Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal? The dimensions of the Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal are approximately 2.5 inches high, 4.9 inches wide, and 5.6 inches deep. Is it possible to stack this pedal with other effects pedals? Yes, the Fender The Trapper Dual Fuzz Effects Pedal can be stacked with other effects pedals
